scope: paired retrieval and generation treatment selection procedure
research_question: Under the same admitted EVAL-010 cases, independently reviewed oracle artifacts and frozen run configuration, does a challenger pass every non-compensable gate and Pareto-dominate the baseline across all pre-specified required case-by-metric coordinates?

retrieval.meaning: current case-scoped PostgreSQL Portuguese lexical FTS baseline using ts_rank_cd

generation.meaning: externally supplied generation challenger with exact provider/model/configuration hash

decision_rules: BLOCKED if either treatment has NOT_TESTED or BLOCKED observations
BLOCKED if a required paired case or required metric is missing
a non-compensable gate failure cannot be averaged away
if baseline passes all hard gates and challenger fails any hard gate, KEEP_BASELINE
if challenger passes all hard gates and baseline fails any hard gate, SELECT_CHALLENGER
if both fail hard gates, NO_CLEAR_WINNER
when both pass hard gates, compare every pre-specified required case-by-metric coordinate
challenger is selected only if it is never worse and is better on at least one required coordinate
baseline is kept only if challenger is never better and is worse on at least one required coordinate
weighted scores, post-hoc metrics and post-hoc tie-breakers are forbidden

external_blocker.reason: No authorized admitted 30-50 case EVAL-010 corpus with independently reviewed structured oracle artifacts is available.
